Meridian Retail Group is a **High Risk** renewal account (estimated renewal probability below 40% without intervention), and that risk is directly tied to NovaLearn’s integration roadmap and permission-friction issues.

- **Integration roadmap gap:** Meridian’s store managers need TutorChat inside Microsoft Teams for mobile, on-the-floor access [NL-026#NL-026-S04]. Sales gave verbal assurances in 2025 that the Teams integration was “almost ready,” but the official roadmap (`NL-014`) schedules the Teams connector only for the **design phase in Q4 2026**, which is **after Meridian’s October 15, 2026 renewal date** [NL-026#NL-026-S02]. This means the critical feature Meridian was promised will not be available before the renewal decision, undermining the account’s ROI justification [NL-026#NL-026-S02][NL-026#NL-026-S04].

- **Permission-friction evidence:** Meridian’s decentralized structure requires strict division-level permissions, but the Growth Plan only offers manual folder-based permission controls, causing ongoing configuration errors [NL-026#NL-026-S02]. The lack of SCIM or Active Directory integration — which are Enterprise-only — forces manual account and permission management whenever retail staff leave or transfer [NL-026#NL-026-S04]. In May 2026, Meridian submitted 18 tickets, including **8 permission verification failures** where store managers were locked out of return-policy folders or assistant managers accessed restricted regional sales data [NL-026#NL-026-S03]. This permission friction is a core risk driver [NL-026#NL-026-S02].

- **How the two combine:** The missing Teams integration prevents convenient floor-level access, while manual permission management creates access errors and administrative overhead. Together, they produced support delays and frustration from Meridian’s VP of Retail Operations, who cited both the Teams gap and support response times as reasons to consider alternatives [NL-026#NL-026-S02][NL-026#NL-026-S04]. The intervention plan therefore proposes a pro-bono Enterprise upgrade to enable automated SCIM/AD provisioning and a possible limited Teams private preview in late Q3 — directly addressing both the integration roadmap gap and the permission friction to try to save the renewal [NL-026#NL-026-S05][NL-026#NL-026-S06].
